build_seq2seq_model: build a Seq2Seq model with an encoder, decoder, and config for code-to-text generation
run_beam_search: run beam search inference on source code to generate natural language descriptions
create_beam_search: create a Beam object with a specified size, start symbol, and end symbol
review_forward_pass: review the Seq2Seq forward pass that computes loss or generates predictions
test_beam_advance: test the Beam advance method to update scores and backpointers during search
